summary: Scaffolded the strict ESM easy-host package with tsc build, Biome, Vitest, a shebang entry that prints the package version and exits 0, and unit coverage. Typecheck, lint, focused and full unit tests, build, and Node 24 runtime checks all pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Scaffolded the strict ESM easy-host package with tsc build, Biome, Vitest, a shebang entry that prints the package version and exits 0, and unit coverage. Typecheck, lint, focused and full unit tests, build, and Node 24 runtime checks all pass.
decisions: Pinned the PRD 7.1 dependency versions in package.json so later tasks inherit a single source of truth.
Kept the entry limited to version output; ten-command registration remains PRE-1.4 scope.
Gated integration and packaging suites behind EASY_HOST_INTEGRATION/EASY_HOST_PACKAGING so the default test run excludes them.
payload.taskDescription: Create the runnable package skeleton. Set up an ESM package named easy-host with bin.easy-host pointing at dist/cli/index.js, engines.node >= 24, and scripts build, typecheck, lint, test, test:integration, test:packaging. Add strict TypeScript 7 configs that emit ESM to dist, a Biome config, and a Vitest config that excludes tests/integration from the default run. Create a minimal src/cli/index.ts with a shebang that prints the version and exits 0, plus a unit test that imports the entry module and asserts the version output. Do not implement any subcommand behavior.
